name: eesy_MMDate – Manage modified date on website or blog
author: eesy

sections.description:
eesy_MMDate is a smart WordPress plugin that helps site owners and bloggers keep their content up to date – without actually rewriting it. By automatically adjusting the modified date of posts or pages at set intervals, you can signal freshness to search engines like Google. This small meta update can have a big impact on how relevant and active your content appears in search results.

Key Features and Benefits:

  1. Automated Post Modified Date Updates

– Updates the modified date of existing blog posts or pages daily without changing the content.
– Helps boost your SEO ranking by signaling recent activity to Google and other search engines.
2. Stay Relevant Without Rewriting
– Maintain high-performing posts at the top of search results by simulating recency.
– Avoids the need for constant content revisions while still benefiting from SEO dynamics.
3. SEO Optimization through Meta Data
– Modified date updates are recognized by search engines as content activity.
– Supports content marketing strategies and improves click-through rates.
4. Simple and Lightweight
– Easy to configure.
– Designed to work smoothly with your existing content and theme setup.
5. Compatible with Any Post Type
– Works with blog posts, custom post types, or static pages.
6. Pro Version Exclusive Features:
– Unlimited amount of posts available for selection
– Can update all posts of a specifc Post Type and Status
– Configurable time frame (e.g., every 2 months) for automatic updates.
– Randomized Update Logic: Add variation to your update schedule – e.g., every 2 months ± 14 days – to simulate organic activity more realistically.
– Custom Meta box in post editor which also enables the manual exclusion/inclusion from the update queue

Workflow with eesy_MMDate

  1. Install and activate the plugin in WordPress.
  2. Select up to 20 posts for update queue
  3. The plugin will automatically refresh the modified date of your selected posts.

Use Cases:

Ideal for website owners, content marketers, SEO professionals, and bloggers who want to maintain a fresh appearance and maximize ranking potential without manually editing old content. Perfect for websites with a large volume of evergreen content that should maintain visibility in search engine results without frequent manual updates.
sections.faq:
General Questions= What does eesy_MMDate do? =

It updates the “last modified” date of your blog posts or pages on a schedule, so they appear fresh to search engines – without altering the actual content.

Why should I update modified dates?

Google and other search engines take the modified date into account when determining the freshness and relevance of content. Regularly updated posts are more likely to rank higher.

Does this plugin change the content itself?

No, only the meta information (the modified date) is updated. Your original content remains untouched.
—### Technical Questions

How does the scheduling work?

A WordPress cron created by the plugin makes hourly checks to see if the selected posts were already updated today. If not, it looks if the specified time is reached. And if that condition is met, it updates the post_modified of all the posts. The new date that will be given each day is calculated from the “Days to Add” field (new post_modified = value + current post_modified). A value of 0 sets it automatically to the current date.
